what: fuzz/targets/syntax_parse.rs lexes the text fast with LexedStr::new for its own checks, then LexedStr::lexes_alike(edition, text) lexes it fast again and with rustc_lexer alone. Please add a method comparing an existing lex with the rustc_lexer-only one, e.g. `pub fn lexes_like_rustc_lexer(&self, edition: Edition, text: &str) -> bool` (same fields compared as lexes_alike: tokens, checkpoints, long, errors), behind the same `fuzz` feature if lexes_alike is. That saves one fast lex per run, about a tenth of syntax_parse run. Tell the owner of fuzz/ when it lands.
